display.purpose: Hero and contact headlines, Archivo at 112% width.

data.purpose: Code, CI job names, acuity marks and domains only.

motion.name: wake
motion.value: 0.6s closed, 0.32s flutter open, 0.2s close, 1.15s expo open

motion.name: blink
motion.purpose: Ambient life while the hero is in view.

motion.name: dive
motion.value: scroll-scrubbed over 85% of a viewport, scale to 18x on the pupil
motion.purpose: Transition from hero into the site.

components.name: Gold Button
components.css: .ds-btn-gold { height: 50px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 999px; border: 0; background: #e3a944; color: #1d1404; font: 600 15px Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -14px rgba(0,0,0,.8); cursor: pointer; transition: background .25s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), transform .2s; } .ds-btn-gold:hover { background: #f0bd5e; } .ds-btn-gold:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(.98); } .ds-btn-gold:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e3a944; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Line Button
components.css: .ds-btn-line { height: 50px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid rgba(239,233,221,.18); background: transparent; color: #efe9dd; font: 600 15px Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-line:hover { background: #171a1b; border-color: rgba(239,233,221,.6); } .ds-btn-line:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e3a944; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Domain Input
components.description: Pill input for the live domain check.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 54px; padding: 0 22px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid rgba(239,233,221,.18); background: #0f1112; color: #efe9dd; font: 15px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(239,233,221,.6); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: rgba(227,169,68,.7); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(227,169,68,.14); }

components.name: Orbit Node
components.description: A tool on the iris orbit; picking it dilates the pupil.
components.css: .ds-node { width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; background: #0b0d0e; border: 1px solid rgba(239,233,221,.26); box-shadow: 0 8px 18px -6px rgba(0,0,0,.8); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color .3s, scale .4s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-node span { width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 8px; background: #0891b2; } .ds-node:hover, .ds-node:focus-visible { border-color: #e3a944; scale: 1.14; outline: none; }

components.name: Chart Row
components.description: One line of the Snellen-style experience chart.
components.html: 20/10010K DEPLOYScanary releases with automated rollback
components.css: .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 80px 1fr 80px; align-items: baseline; text-align: center; color: #efe9dd; } .ds-ac { font: 12px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; color: rgba(239,233,221,.6); text-align: left; } .ds-big { grid-column: 2; font: 800 56px/1 Archivo, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .04em; } .ds-fine { grid-column: 2; margin-top: 10px; font: 14px Archivo, sans-serif; color: rgba(239,233,221,.6); }

narrative.overview: Het's work is observability, so the site is an eye. It wakes on load, his tools orbit in a generative hazel iris, his results sit in the white of the eye wired by gold veins, and scrolling dives through the pupil into the rest of the page. Lid-dark ground, iris gold and moss, sclera type; almonds, rings and lenses; 1px rules, no boxes.

rules.name: One Pupil Rule
rules.body: The pupil is the ground colour so the dive lands seamlessly.

rules.name: Gold Means Look Here
rules.body: Gold marks one thing per region: a number, an action or progress.

rules.name: Wide Means Display
rules.body: Expanded widths are for headings only.

dos: Wire every new tool into the orbit and every headline number into the sclera and chart.
Keep all motion off under reduced motion.
donts: No boxed cards, eyebrow labels, gradient text or glow shadows.
